column1: # Stage S10 H1a, second of four: the frontend's interface primitives (`foundation/ui`) and its small
# helpers (`foundation/utils`) become crates/frontend/foundation/frontend_ui, with every module at the
# folder becomes the crate's `src`, its module tree `lib.rs` (the utils module lines join it by hand)
# and its README the crate README; the utils files move one by one beside it, its README becoming the
# source tree README. Each prefix is one `crate::` row scoped to the ui folder (the crate's `src`,
# which also receives the utils files) and one `frontend_ui::` row scoped to the app's source.
# The utilities moved file by file into the same `src` as the ui folder, so the two rows above,
# scoped to the ui folder that becomes frontend_ui/src, also judge every moved utility file.
